entities.summary: The Polish-Catholic Church in the Republic of Poland, also known as the Church of Poland or Polish-Catholic Church, is a Polish Old Catholic church in Poland. Polish-Catholic Church of Republic of Poland is a Christian denomination in Europe, established in 1924. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
